with open('/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/exp028b_qwen3_thinking_folio204/exp028b_results.json') as f:

b = 0  # SICA correct, SC wrong

print(f'discordant: b(SICA wins)={b}, c(SC wins)={c}, b/(b+c)={b/(b+c)*100:.1f}%' if b+c>0 else 'discordant: 0')
"
